name: workstreams
description: Workstream board, charters, tmux sidebar and active-session dispatch

jiraUrl.title: Jira site
jiraUrl.description: The Jira site that issue keys in replies link to, such as https://example.atlassian.net. Unset, no key is linked.

jiraProjectKeys.title: Jira project keys
jiraProjectKeys.description: The Jira project keys to link, such as PROJ or OPS. Unset, no key is linked.

githubRepos.title: GitHub repositories
githubRepos.description: The repositories whose refs link, as owner/repo, such as octo-org/widgets; a reply's widgets #12 then links to that issue or pull request. Unset, no ref is linked.
